children: Lease income rose modestly year over year, while net income increased sharply. Higher rent from the December 2025 CPI adjustment and the absence of prior-year impairment and property-sale losses drove the earnings improvement; higher legal fees related to ongoing litigation and REA negotiations partly offset it.
¹ Reported as “Lease income”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Net income per certificate - basic and diluted”.
: The Trust owned 117 retail properties across 35 states and Puerto Rico, totaling 15.5 million square feet of leasable space at September 30, 2026.
: Quarterly lease income increased by $243, primarily due to the December 2025 CPI adjustment to base rent.
: General and administrative expenses rose by $1.104M, primarily from higher legal fees related to ongoing litigation and REA negotiations.
: No properties were sold during the nine months ended September 30, 2026; four retail properties were sold in the comparable 2025 period.
